entities.summary: Monsignor Crescente Errázuriz Valdivieso was a Chilean Dominican friar and prelate of the Catholic Church who served as the archbishop of Santiago de Chile from 1919 to his death in 1931. He was also a professor, writer and historian. Crescente Errázuriz was of Basque descent.
